title: Loan EMI Calculator - Monthly Payments & Amortization
description: Calculate monthly loan EMI, total interest, full amortization schedule, and payoff savings with extra monthly payments. Free online loan calculator.
quickAnswer: Loan EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) is computed using the annuity formula: EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n ÷ ((1 + r)^n − 1), where P is principal, r is monthly interest rate (annual rate ÷ 1200), and n is total months. Total interest equals (EMI × n) − P. Making extra monthly payments reduces principal directly, cutting total interest and loan tenure.

commonMistakes.title: Focusing Only on Monthly Payment
commonMistakes.description: Extending loan tenure lowers your monthly payment but drastically balloons total lifetime interest charges. Always evaluate total loan cost alongside monthly cash flow.

commonMistakes.title: Confusing APR with Base Interest Rate
commonMistakes.description: An annual percentage rate (APR) includes lender fees, points, and closing costs, whereas the nominal note rate dictates your exact monthly amortization calculation.

commonMistakes.title: Assuming Equal Principal Reduction
commonMistakes.description: During the early years of a loan, the vast majority of each payment goes toward interest. Principal reduction accelerates only in the latter half of the amortization schedule.

faqs.q: What is an EMI (Equated Monthly Installment)?
faqs.a: An Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) is a fixed monthly payment made by a borrower to a lender on a specified calendar date. Each installment covers both interest accrued for the month and a portion of the principal balance.

faqs.q: What is the standard formula for calculating loan EMI?
faqs.a: The standard EMI formula is: EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1), where P is the loan principal, r is the periodic monthly interest rate (annual rate divided by 1200), and n is the total number of monthly payments.

faqs.q: How does paying extra each month shorten loan duration?
faqs.a: Any payment above the required EMI is credited entirely against the loan's outstanding principal balance. With a smaller principal, future monthly interest charges decrease, accelerating repayment and saving substantial interest charges.

faqs.q: Does this loan calculator support multiple international currencies?
faqs.a: Yes. You can switch between PKR, INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, and SAR without changing the mathematical annuity formula.

faqs.q: Can I export my full amortization schedule?
faqs.a: Yes. Click the 'Download Schedule (CSV)' button to export your complete month-by-month payment, interest, principal, and balance schedule as a CSV spreadsheet.

faqs.q: Is my personal loan data uploaded to any server?
faqs.a: No. All loan computations execute 100% locally in your web browser. No financial numbers or loan amounts are transmitted or saved.
